name: kiekie
description: Screenshot collection & annotation system — Cloudflare Worker + local MCP server

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace mcp
scripts.e2e:server: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace mcp && npm run e2e:migrate --workspace worker && npm run e2e:dev --workspace worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build --workspace web && npm run migrate:remote --workspace worker && npm run deploy --workspace worker
